rows.locator: GM §13.1 opening dyadic reduction; MP Lemma 24; elementary eta identity
rows.statement: The Type-II exponent obeys 2(1-sigma)<=A(sigma) by an exact positive residual. For every epsilon>0, summing positive shells U=T/2^j gives sum_j U^(A+epsilon)<=T^(A+epsilon)/(1-2^(-A-epsilon)); fixed low shells are O(1). There is no real non-trivial zeta zero because eta(s)>0 and zeta(s)=eta(s)/(1-2^(1-s))<0 for 0<s<1; conjugation therefore changes the positive-height multiplicity count by exactly two.
